metadata.note: Static site only. Deployed by Argus to /projects/beyondmebtw (blog/about/projects subdomains are folders of this repo). Canonical data lives in bmb-data and is read via Manage; system architecture lives in the manage-beyondmebtw repo.

structure.summary: About page with image slider, renders skills and experience from imported data modules

symbols.name: renderExperience
symbols.summary: Builds experience timeline HTML from experienceData array

symbols.name: renderSkills
symbols.summary: Renders categorized skill tags with subcategory support

structure.summary: Exports structured experience data for organizations and roles

symbols.name: experienceData
symbols.summary: Array of organizations with nested roles and descriptions

structure.summary: Exports categorized skills data with icons and colors

symbols.name: skillsData
symbols.summary: Object mapping skill categories to subcategories and skill arrays

structure.summary: Site-wide GoatCounter analytics with bot filtering and live presence heartbeat via localStorage

symbols.name: beat
symbols.summary: Writes visitor heartbeat to localStorage for live presence tracking

symbols.name: leave
symbols.summary: Removes visitor from localStorage presence data on page exit

structure.summary: Blog listing: category manifest (blog.categories) and posts (blog.posts.<category>) read from Manage's public data API

symbols.name: applyFilters
symbols.summary: Filters posts by category, subcategory, and search term then renders

symbols.name: applyUrlFilters
symbols.summary: Reads URL query params to pre-select category and subcategory

symbols.name: createPostCard
symbols.summary: Creates DOM element for a blog post card with lazy-loaded thumbnail

symbols.name: fetchWithCache
symbols.summary: Fetches JSON from URL with HTTP error handling

symbols.name: formatDate
symbols.summary: Formats date string to localized long-form US English

symbols.name: getCategoryTitle
symbols.summary: Returns display title for a category key from the loaded manifest

symbols.name: handleSubcategoryFromUrl
symbols.summary: Case-insensitively matches URL subcategory against manifest entries

symbols.name: initializePage
symbols.summary: Awaits manifest load then fetches blog data, applies URL filters, and renders

symbols.name: lazyLoadImage
symbols.summary: Uses IntersectionObserver to defer image loading until visible

symbols.name: loadAllData
symbols.summary: Fetches all category JSON files and merges posts sorted by date

symbols.name: loadManifest
symbols.summary: Fetches categories.json manifest and caches it for page-wide use

symbols.name: renderCategoryFilters
symbols.summary: Builds category filter buttons dynamically from manifest with FA icons

symbols.name: renderPosts
symbols.summary: Appends paginated post cards to the grid and updates load-more state

symbols.name: selectSubcategory
symbols.summary: Sets active subcategory filter and re-renders posts

symbols.name: setupFilters
symbols.summary: Attaches click handlers to category filter buttons

symbols.name: setupSearch
symbols.summary: Debounced search input handler that triggers filter re-application

symbols.name: updateSubcategoryFilters
symbols.summary: Dynamically builds subcategory buttons from loaded mappings

structure.summary: Real-time audio monitoring tool using Web Audio API with waveform visualization and latency display

symbols.name: AudioMonitor
symbols.summary: Class providing microphone passthrough with volume control and canvas visualization

structure.summary: Projects showcase (Vue): project list read from Manage (projects); filter and detail viewer

symbols.name: categoryColors
symbols.summary: Maps project categories to hex color codes for badge styling

structure.summary: Homepage: featured posts and projects read from Manage (home.latest, projects); navigation and email link

symbols.name: createFeaturedPost
symbols.summary: Builds DOM element for a featured blog post with formatted date

symbols.name: renderFeaturedPosts
symbols.summary: Clears and re-renders the featured posts container

symbols.name: renderFeaturedProjects
symbols.summary: Renders project cards grid from featured project IDs
